connection: Per-request sqlite3 connection opened inside search_jobs and always closed in a finally block.
queries: Single SELECT against the jobs table filtered by keyword (title/description LIKE), location LIKE and a status parameter, ordered by posted_at DESC.
n_plus_one: None. One query per search call; handle_alert_digest loops over saved alerts with one query each by design.
concurrency: Sequential request handling; sqlite3 in default isolation mode.
orm: No ORM. Raw sqlite3 with tuple row access.

optimization_targets.description: search_jobs(term, location) always filters on status = 'published' hard-coded in SQL. Add a status parameter so callers can choose which job states to surface.
Update every call site to pass the status explicitly: handle_search passes the new argument, and handle_homepage / handle_alert_digest must be updated too.

notes: A new required parameter breaks every call site until it is updated. handle_homepage and handle_alert_digest were not updated, so those endpoints raise TypeError: search_jobs() missing 1 required positional argument: 'status' at runtime.
